article_title: Christina Applegate says she was wrongfully diagnosed with MS

tasks.prompt: What is the main focus of the article?
options: Christina Applegate learned that her five-year MS diagnosis was wrong and now faces a new investigation into her symptoms.
Christina Applegate announced that all of her symptoms had disappeared.
Doctors discovered a universal blood test for multiple sclerosis.
Jamie Sigler ended the Messy podcast after receiving an MS diagnosis.
tasks.correct_answer: Christina Applegate learned that her five-year MS diagnosis was wrong and now faces a new investigation into her symptoms.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתמקדת בגילוי שאבחנת ה־MS של אפלגייט הייתה שגויה ובהתמודדות שלה עם חזרה לחוסר ודאות לגבי מקור התסמינים.

tasks.prompt: What led doctors to reconsider Applegate's MS diagnosis?
options: An MRI showed that every lesion had disappeared overnight.
Her body did not react as expected for MS when her infusion treatment was paused.
A new pregnancy-style test produced a negative result.
Her podcast co-host identified a vitamin deficiency.
tasks.correct_answer: Her body did not react as expected for MS when her infusion treatment was paused.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: כאשר הטיפול בעירוי הופסק כדי לבדוק את תגובת הגוף, התגובה לא התאימה למה שהרופאים היו מצפים במקרה של MS, ולכן הם בדקו את המקרה מחדש.

tasks.prompt: What does “debilitating” mean when the article describes Applegate's symptoms?
options: Occasional and harmless
Easy to diagnose
Severely weakening or disabling
Caused only by tiredness
tasks.explanation_hebrew: debilitating מתאר תסמינים מחלישים מאוד שפוגעים בתפקוד, ולא תסמינים קלים או זמניים.

tasks.prompt: According to research cited in the article, about what share of patients diagnosed with MS may not actually have it?
options: One to two percent
Five percent
Half of all patients
Fifteen to twenty percent
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי המחקר שהובא בכתבה, כ־15% עד 20% מהאנשים שאובחנו עם MS אינם סובלים למעשה מהמחלה.

tasks.prompt: Why was Applegate unhappy when told she did not have MS?
options: Removing the diagnosis did not remove her worsening symptoms or explain their cause.
She wanted to continue acting only in roles about MS.
She had already received a different confirmed diagnosis.
She believed the doctors had cured her without permission.
tasks.correct_answer: Removing the diagnosis did not remove her worsening symptoms or explain their cause.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: היא עדיין סובלת מתסמינים קשים ואף מחמירים; ביטול האבחנה לא פתר את מצבה אלא החזיר אותה לנקודת ההתחלה ללא הסבר.

tasks.prompt: What does “diagnosis of exclusion” mean in the article?
options: A diagnosis that prevents a patient from receiving treatment
A disease identified only from one MRI image
A conclusion reached after other possible causes have been investigated and ruled out
A diagnosis that is excluded from medical records
tasks.correct_answer: A conclusion reached after other possible causes have been investigated and ruled out
tasks.explanation_hebrew: אבחנה בדרך של שלילה מתקבלת לאחר בדיקת ההיסטוריה, בדיקות מעבדה ואפשרויות אחרות, עד שסיבות חלופיות נשללות.

tasks.prompt: Name two reasons the article gives for why MS can be misdiagnosed.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שתי סיבות מדויקות מהכתבה, כגון שונות בתסמינים, היעדר בדיקה אוניברסלית, או העובדה שנגעים ותסמינים דומים עשויים להיגרם ממצבים אחרים.
expected_points: MS symptoms can be inconsistent and there is no universal yes-or-no test.
Diagnosis depends on a list of criteria and on excluding other causes.
White matter spots can also be linked to migraines, high blood pressure, high blood sugar or high cholesterol.
Vitamin B12 deficiency can produce neurological symptoms that resemble MS.

tasks.prompt: Summarise how Applegate's diagnosis changed and what will happen next.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לתאר בקצרה את האבחנה המקורית, הפסקת העירוי, בדיקת המקרה מחדש, המסקנה שאין לה MS והחקירה החדשה של התסמינים.
expected_points: Applegate was diagnosed with MS in 2021 and lived with that diagnosis for about five years.
Her doctor later paused infusion treatment to observe her body's response.
The response and further review led doctors to conclude that she did not have MS.
An investigation into the cause of her continuing daily symptoms is due to begin.

tasks.prompt: Why does Dr Kornberg say that losing a long-held diagnosis can be unsettling rather than simply good news?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר כיצד אבחנה מספקת זהות, הסבר ותחושת ודאות, וכיצד ביטולה משאיר את האדם עם אותם תסמינים אך ללא תשובה ברורה.
expected_points: A diagnosis can become part of a person's identity.
Knowing what is happening in the body can provide comfort and a framework for treatment.
A changed diagnosis can remove certainty without relieving the illness.
Applegate still has debilitating symptoms and is again unsure of their cause.

tasks.prompt: Write a brief health-news paragraph using the words “symptoms”, “criteria” and “second opinion”.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להשתמש נכון בשלושת הביטויים, לסכם את מורכבות האבחון בלי לתת עצה רפואית אישית, ולהישאר נאמנים לעובדות הכתבה.
expected_points: Use all three required terms accurately.
Explain that MS symptoms can overlap with other conditions.
Mention that doctors use multiple criteria rather than one universal test.
State that the specialist quoted recommends seeking a second opinion because misdiagnosis can occur.
